title: Map zoom lag: warning flood + per-frame marker re-renders
description: Profiled with CDP during continuous wheel zoom (dev): worst frame 486ms. Costs, in order: (1) vite client stringifyConsoleArg ~380ms serializing the Vue 'missing template or render function' warning fired per pin mount — root cause is pb-xua (FA IconDefinition passed to MapIconTextPin's icon: Component prop); (2) Vue setFullProps/updateProps ~300ms — every pin re-renders on every fractional zoom tick because LandingPage passes raw zoom into ClusteredMarkers, though supercluster rounds internally and MapIconTextPin only uses zoom for size buckets (<12 dot, 12-14 small, >=14 large per map-core d.ts); (3) inherent maplibre Marker._update. Fix: cached FA wrapper components (stable identity, module-level cache in reportIcon.ts) closing pb-xua, and Math.round(zoom) at the ClusteredMarkers boundary in LandingPage (LocationAccuracyCircle keeps fractional zoom). Marker DOM churn at bucket crossings (279 adds/removals per 4s zoom) is inherent clustering behavior, acceptable once per-pin cost drops.
acceptance_criteria: Zero Vue warnings during zoom; pins re-render only on integer zoom crossings; wheel-zoom worst frame under ~100ms in dev; suite green.

title: Primary-color token hygiene in philly-311 + packages/ui
description: Final integration review findings: (1) ReportCallout.vue:42,57 falls back to #1034f4 under var(--ui-color-primary,...) while every other consumer falls back to #0f4d90 — token is defined nowhere in phila-ui-core 3.0.0 light template, so fallbacks ARE the rendered colors; two different blues under one name. description: Found during pb-exd verification. Vue warns 'Component is missing template or render function' per pin; DOM shows . Live pins are plain blue circles; design shows white glyphs (trash/car/etc.) on per-category colored circles. Fix pattern already exists in-repo: FilterChips.vue wraps FA definitions as functional components — do the same for pins (shared helper). Also design shows per-category circle colors; verify MapIconTextPin supports icon color per instance or needs the category color passed.
